task: Continuous real-browser mobile recording harness implementation

execution.reason: Per instruction: coordinator runs only after integration/deployment. No browser launched, no live URL fetched, and no recording or runtime assertions claimed.

method: Puppeteer page.screencast captures a continuous actual browser compositor stream to WebM before any typing; ffmpeg transcodes that same source to H.264/yuv420p/faststart MP4. Checkpoint PNGs are never used as video input.
encodingNote: H.264 yuv420p requires even dimensions; MP4 is padded right/bottom by exactly 1 black pixel to 376x740 without scaling/cropping viewport content. Source WebM and screenshots remain 375x739.
selectorSourceCheck: All primary IDs found directly or as COMPOSER_ID/PLAYBACK_BAR_ID template-generated IDs in current local source; no known missing selectors. Runtime presence/visibility/occlusion is intentionally not claimed.

interactionPolicy.typing: page.type on real visible focused fields; native keyboard Enter submits exact prompt
interactionPolicy.pointer: hit-tested touchscreen.tap; native mouse wheel on actual visible scroll ancestors
interactionPolicy.evaluate: read-only DOM, geometry, scene state and camera observations
forbiddenFeaturesAbsent: storage writes outside actual Save UI

cleanup.supervision: Worker launched detached in its own POSIX process group; Chromium manually spawned non-detached and driven by puppeteer.connect so early launch failures cannot escape cleanup; ffmpeg inherits the same group. Supervisor kills entire group on normal exit, signals, errors and timeout.
cleanup.recordingStop: Native recorder stop+stream flush in finally; also requested on abort.
cleanup.temporaryProfile: Dedicated /tmp profile removed by supervisor; supplied output artifacts retained.

runtimeMetadata: JSON contains recording start/stop/end, first typing time, each assertion status/time/data, native-action trace, screenshot paths/dimensions, actual camera samples, ffprobe metadata, MP4 atom ordering, missing/blocked selectors and honest failure messages.
knownLimitations: Live behavior remains untested pending deployment.
MP4 raster is 376x740 only because H.264 yuv420p cannot encode odd 375x739 dimensions.
Requires Linux process groups and installed Chromium/ffmpeg/ffprobe.
